provisional_note: Candidate DRY component-family roles exercised by Atlas, for audit adjudication. Names are design roles, not final component IDs. The audit agent later adjudicates exact canonical names. Each entry states role, used_by (which Atlas region/flow), and reuse_note (how it composes with the shared grammar and what to preserve on Slint port).

component_families.name: SettingsWorkspaceShell
component_families.role: The focus+context workspace container: holds the active region's continuous-document main pane, the minimap rail (context), and the viewport rail (in-view subcategory). Owns category-load-one-at-a-time, controlled-jump scrollspy, and the route/open deeplink target.
component_families.reuse_note: Shared across all four concepts (each composes it differently). Preserve on Slint: model-backed scroll position (no DOM measurement), layout-driven reflow at narrow widths (collapse minimap + viewport rail below 1280px), accessible main-content region.

component_families.name: SettingsSearch
component_families.role: Cross-category fuzzy multi-token search returning typed results (scalar setting, manager destination, one-shot action, read-only status, diagnostic, setup workflow, unavailable capability). Atlas variant = Cmd+K overlay that dims the map.
component_families.reuse_note: Search indexes metadata without eagerly opening all managers (lazy hydration). Slint: popup/focus-scope overlay; map-dim via semi-transparent rectangle, not filter stack. Preserve deep-link + focus-highlight on result select.

component_families.name: SettingsDestination
component_families.role: A destination control communicating title, purpose, optional health/setup summary, and clear navigation affordance. Atlas variant = bounded region sized by content density with a you-are-here marker.
component_families.reuse_note: Replaces filter-pill silhouette (supersession). Never reads as a chip. Slint: render via repeater over category model; density-encoded grid spans translate to layout containers.

component_families.name: SettingsNotice
component_families.role: One stable status treatment, one actionable headline, one short reason, at most one primary + one quiet secondary action. Categories: needs-attention / continue-setup / recommended.
component_families.reuse_note: Do not repeat category/type/urgency/status in four text layers. Alert/Attention lives in the stable status area, not in the explanatory sentence. Title-bar notification stack is the SOLE in-app surface — no separate notification panel.

component_families.name: CategoryNavigation
component_families.role: Region grid + minimap: select a category/region; communicates density + current region + needs-attention border.
component_families.reuse_note: Atlas-specific: navigation is territorial, not a list. Slint: model-backed active-region indicator; controlled jump (no scroll jump). Shared semantics with sibling concepts' category nav.

component_families.name: SubcategoryScrollspy
component_families.role: Synchronizes the in-view subcategory with the left-nav/minimap indicator as the document scrolls; clicking a subcategory performs a controlled jump.
component_families.reuse_note: Atlas uses it twice (minimap + viewport thumb). Slint: drive from ListView item-index model, NOT pixel measurement. Reduced motion preserves every state and action.

component_families.name: SettingRow
component_families.role: The unit setting grammar: title, concise explanation, current value/state, default or source, scope, availability, restart/reconnect requirement, help/details, validation/error. Renders the nine explicit value states.
component_families.reuse_note: Shared grammar backbone. Exposure levels Standard/Advanced/Expert/Managed/Diagnostic/Unavailable; search finds all levels. Auto/Inherit/Not configured/Disabled never render as empty string.

component_families.name: ValueSourceBadge
component_families.role: Visual marker for the nine value states (Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective differs).
used_by: theme mode effective_variant (Auto resolves to light/dark)
component_families.reuse_note: Consumes the settings_schema_impacts setting_value_state_enum. RequestedEffectiveInspector composes it for requested vs effective pairs.

component_families.name: ManagerShell
component_families.role: Manager header + search/filter + add/connect/create action + health summary + resource list/card/detail + requested/effective + loading/empty/failed/unavailable/managed states + logs/receipts/diagnostics access.
component_families.reuse_note: Every manager feels designed by the same team. A manager may compose differently when the domain demands, but reuses shared semantics and component families. Manager load does not block the entire workspace (lazy hydration).

component_families.name: ResourceList
component_families.role: Card/table list of resources with health, provenance, and lifecycle actions.
component_families.reuse_note: Composes with ResourceCard + ResourceDetail. Slint: virtualized/segmented for long lists (sound library, dictionaries).

component_families.name: ResourceCard
component_families.role: Single-resource card with status, provenance, and primary action.
component_families.reuse_note: Domain cards specialize the shared card. ProviderFamilyCard/AccountConnectionRow/InstallationCard are domain specializations reused from the provider grammar.

component_families.name: ResourceDetail
component_families.role: Detail editor/inspector for a selected resource.
used_by: installation advanced detail (configured command/resolved launcher/actual executable/package identity/discovery evidence/confidence)
component_families.reuse_note: May use different internal composition per domain but reuses shared semantics.

component_families.name: HealthSummary
component_families.role: Aggregate health/setup summary for a manager: ready/needs-setup/unavailable/managed/degraded states with reasons.
used_by: Provider region (catalog freshness, connection health, verification state)
component_families.reuse_note: Never maps an unknown state to an enabled action. Preserves exact owner reason for disabled projections.

component_families.name: NotificationDestination
component_families.role: Card+editor for one of 8 destination kinds (in_app_title_bar [sole in-app], system_tray, slack, discord, generic_webhook, ntfy, pushover, telegram) with channel/thread/mentions/headers/template/success_predicate/priority/parse_mode/retry/device_selection + credential_ref.
component_families.reuse_note: SecretField composes for credential_ref (webhook URL, bot tokens). Test action is masked + rate-limited + receipted. NEVER route local sound preview through external delivery.

component_families.name: SoundLibraryItem
component_families.role: Card for a built-in/uploaded/pack sound asset with source/license/version/duration/sha256 metadata, verification badge, local-only preview, and lifecycle actions (delete/replace/export).
component_families.reuse_note: Local-only preview bound to a PM-local audio service (no DOM <audio> on Slint). Unverified packs never bundled. Replace preserves mappings or remaps explicitly.

component_families.name: ThemePreview
component_families.role: Live hover preview of a theme/family/mode/custom-TOML patch with ttl; apply commits; invalid falls back to base.
component_families.reuse_note: Slint: precompiled token sets (no runtime var()/color-mix() chains per F3-431). Fallback resolves at load time. Restart markers where a token (font) requires restart.

component_families.name: SetupFlowLauncher
component_families.role: Launches a guided setup/onboarding flow (Free Models setup, provider explicit install, dictionary language pack install).
used_by: Free Models row (wrapper over routes, owns no credentials)
provider explicit Install from official source
component_families.reuse_note: Provider CLI initial acquisition stays explicit/official-source/never bundled. Free Models never owns credentials/quota/switching/Usage.

component_families.name: ObservableOperation
component_families.role: Truthful phased projection of a long operation (resolving → dispatching → verifying → committing; or hydrating → ready).
component_families.reuse_note: No permanent spinner. Wait states show truthful phases. Slint-portable (no browser-only physics).

component_families.name: ReceiptLink
component_families.role: Links a UI outcome to an immutable receipt/dispatch record (dispatch_id, result_status, masked_target, latency, failure_detail).
component_families.reuse_note: Raw secrets never appear in receipts. Receipts form the audit trail. Replays display original result without implying a second side effect.

component_families.name: SecretField
component_families.role: PM-owned secret input vs secure vault/reference selector vs CLI-owned auth vs environment-backed secret vs command-helper/vault-backed secret vs non-secret text. Distinguishes reveal/copy/persist/test semantics by type.
used_by: notification destination credentials (webhook URL, bot tokens) → SecretReference
API-key provider connections → PM-owned secret input
component_families.reuse_note: Atlas uses SecretField/SecretReference for notification + API-key credentials. CLI-owned OAuth (Claude/Antigravity) is NOT a SecretField — it stays behind a CLI-owned boundary with no PM-side secret input. Normal UI never exposes raw tokens.

component_families.name: AvailabilityReason
component_families.role: Renders why a row/control is unavailable, managed, locked, or degraded with the exact owner reason.
component_families.reuse_note: Never maps an unknown state to an enabled action; preserves exact owner reason (stale projection, permission failure, operation in progress, source verification failure, missing confirmation).

component_families.name: RequestedEffectiveInspector
component_families.role: Shows requested vs effective value/route and why a fallback occurred.
used_by: theme Auto requested vs OS-resolved effective_variant
component_families.reuse_note: Composes ValueSourceBadge. Shared with sibling concepts' Goal concurrency and Crew composition inspectors.

families_not_exercised_by_atlas.note: These DRY families belong to sibling-owned domains; Atlas does not exercise them but reaches the domains via shared grammar.

portability_guardrails: Drive scrollspy + minimap from model-backed item-index, not pixel/DOM measurement.
Precompile theme token sets; no runtime CSS var()/color-mix() chains (F3-431).
Bind sound preview to a PM-local audio service; no DOM <audio> in Slint.
Glass themes: bake one backdrop blur over a pre-baked wallpaper; opaque-plate fallback for the refresh overlay.
Cmd+K overlay = popup/focus-scope + semi-transparent dim rectangle, not a filter stack.
